channel.description: Latest articles from The Real News (therealnews.com)

item.title: Israel’s US-backed assault on Gaza set stage for collective punishment in Cuba, AOC says
item.description: “This is a new kind of era of depravity opened up,” said the congresswoman. “There was this stated commitment on human rights—that innocent civilians were almost exempt from the rules of war, from blockades.”

item.title: Inside the right-wing movement pushing Alberta to secede from Canada
item.description: Trump officials have repeatedly met with secessionist leaders from the province, which has large oil and gas deposits.

item.title: Israel just started legalizing its annexation of the West Bank. Here’s what that means.
item.description: The Israeli government recently took radical steps to change the legal status quo in the West Bank. Here’s what these changes mean and how they set the stage for annexation.

item.title: Trump orders Defense, Energy Departments to reinvest in coal
item.description: One study showed that coal power plants led to nearly half a million U.S. deaths over a 20-year period.

item.title: Republicans approve ‘dystopian’ voter suppression bill that would force states to give info to DHS
item.description: “The campaign to rig our elections is well underway,” warned one expert.

item.title: Massive strike at Kaiser Permanente enters third week with new unions joining the picket line
item.description: “It is not the same Kaiser… This is no longer a place to get your care. This is now an investment firm that dabbles in hospitals.”

item.title: Long Island Audit Reveals The Cost of Fighting ICE
item.description: Sean-Paul Reyes of the YouTube channel Long Island Audits dared to audit the facilities of Department of Homeland Security and confront ICE agents with his cameras. He explains the dangers of those actions as well as the difficulties in helping his viewers understand the importance of holding federal agents accountable.

item.title: NO DEAL: Nurses at NY-Presbyterian overwhelmingly vote to stay on strike
item.description: “This has always been about getting a fair contract. We never wanted to go on strike… We want to do our jobs, we love our jobs, but we can only return when our patients are being cared for safely… with more staffing and job security.”

item.title: Data center giant secures $14 million deal to consume 40% of Pennsylvania town’s excess water
item.description: The data center will get access to 400,000 gallons of water per day—enough to serve over 2,300 homes.

item.title: SOS: The US is manufacturing a humanitarian crisis in Cuba
item.description: “I need to believe that Cuba is going to survive this. We are survivors, the whole Cuban population. But the situation is really critical…”
